name: 4 PCS Refrigerator Liners Washable Waterproof Oilproof EVA Refrigerator Mats for Home Kitchen
description:
Waterproof & Oilproof

Made of EVA plastic that protects against spills, oil, and moisture.
Antifouling & Mildew Resistant

Prevents dirt, mold, and bacteria buildup—keeps your fridge clean and fresh.
Flexible & Cuttable

Can be trimmed to fit any shelf, drawer, or cabinet with scissors.
Non-Slip Design

Textured bottom helps keep the liner in place—no adhesive needed.
Washable & Reusable

Just wipe or rinse and reuse—eco-friendly and long-lasting.
Food-Grade Material

BPA-free, odorless, and safe to place food on.
Multi-Purpose Use

Suitable for refrigerators, cabinets, drawers, dining tables, shoe racks, and more.
Colorful & Decorative

Comes in soft, bright colors or transparent designs to make your fridge more organized and visually pleasing.
